card.name: Just before the next symptom in overdose lists
card.fires_on: Commas, short modifiers, or word starts inside lists of overdose or toxicity signs, just before the next symptom is named. Often it sits where a cardiovascular or autonomic term such as hypotension, instability or myoclonus comes next.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom
modes.description: The comma closing one item in a list of symptoms, with the next item still to come.

modes.label: Modifier before a symptom
modes.description: A short intensity or timing word placed right before a symptom term.

modes.label: Inside a split word
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a longer clinical word.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word beginnings like hem- and anal-, and away from unrelated pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of lists of toxic effects, just before the next sign such as low blood pressure or muscle jerks.
